description: Get llms-full.txt for any link: the llms.txt index followed by the full Markdown of up to 20 pages it links to (or the page/document itself; for a video, its description and timestamped transcript). Can be large — prefer llms_txt when you only need to find pages. Cached 24h.

crawl.description: A channel or profile only: how many of its newest items are opened and described (0–10). Defaults: YouTube 5, GitHub 5, Instagram 4, TikTok 4, X 5. Another depth is cached apart and, when built, counts as ceil(crawl ÷ default) new links (at least 1). Other links ignore it.

fresh.description: Ignore the 24h cache and rebuild. Default false.

url.description: Any public http(s) link, e.g. "docs.stripe.com/payments", "github.com/honojs/hono", a PDF or a video URL. The scheme is optional.

name: llms_full_txt
title: llms-full.txt for a link
